paper.title_en: Calibrating the cosmic distance ladder for independent dark energy constraints
paper.abstract_en: Recent cosmological results presented by the DESI collaboration show a clear deviation from the $Λ$CDM model when considering a time-dependent dark energy equation of state. This deviation is strongly driven by the SNe Ia surveys, which all share the same low redshift sample. The ZTF survey provides the current larger SNe Ia sample at low redshift, which will significantly increase the constraining power. In this context, the LEMAITRE collaboration aims to provide new constraints on dark energy parameters using three independent SNe Ia datasets: ZTF, SNLS and HSC. This effort requires robust photometric calibration, with a particular focus on filter transmission measurement and star catalog calibration. The target for LEMAITRE is to control the calibration systematics on distance moduli below 0.4%.
